paragraphs.text: Revenue from operations for {{p:2026-04}} stood at {{m:revenue@2026-04}}, an increase of {{mv:revenue.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:revenue.mom@2026-04:pct}}) over the previous month. On a year-on-year basis, revenue declined by {{mv:revenue.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:revenue.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) compared to the same month last year.

Profit before tax for the month was {{m:pbt@2026-04}}, down {{mv:pbt.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:pbt.mom@2026-04:pct}}) from the previous month and down {{mv:pbt.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:pbt.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) from the same month last year. Profit after tax mirrored this movement at {{m:pat@2026-04}}, there being no tax charge recorded for the month.

Direct costs for the month were {{m:direct_costs@2026-04}}, up {{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:pct}}) over the previous month and up {{mv:direct_costs.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:direct_costs.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) over the same month last year. This increase in costs, alongside the revenue movement, resulted in gross profit of {{m:gross_profit@2026-04}}, a decrease of {{mv:gross_profit.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:gross_profit.mom@2026-04:pct}}) month-on-month and {{mv:gross_profit.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:gross_profit.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year.

EBITDA for the month was {{m:ebitda@2026-04}}, down {{mv:ebitda.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:ebitda.mom@2026-04:pct}}) over the previous month and down {{mv:ebitda.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:ebitda.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) over the same month last year. Other income was {{m:other_income@2026-04}}, a decline of {{mv:other_income.mom@2026-04:abs}} from the previous month. Depreciation for the month was {{m:depreciation@2026-04}}, down {{mv:depreciation.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:depreciation.mom@2026-04:pct}}) month-on-month but up {{mv:depreciation.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:depreciation.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year.

Trade receivables stood at {{m:receivables@2026-04}}, broadly stable month-on-month at {{mv:receivables.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:receivables.mom@2026-04:pct}}) but up {{mv:receivables.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:receivables.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) over the same month last year. Trade payables were {{m:payables@2026-04}}, up {{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:pct}}) month-on-month and {{mv:payables.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:payables.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) year-on-year.

Cash and bank balances were {{m:cash_and_bank@2026-04}}, up {{mv:cash_and_bank.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:cash_and_bank.mom@2026-04:pct}}) over the previous month and sharply higher by {{mv:cash_and_bank.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:cash_and_bank.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) compared to the same month last year. Overall working capital stood at {{m:working_capital@2026-04}}, an increase of {{mv:working_capital.mom@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:working_capital.mom@2026-04:pct}}) over the previous month and {{mv:working_capital.yoy@2026-04:abs}} ({{mv:working_capital.yoy@2026-04:pct}}) over the same month last year.

output.summary: Direct costs more than doubled month-on-month while revenue grew only slightly, compressing gross margin and EBITDA sharply; payables also jumped. These trends warrant immediate review.

actions.heading: Investigate direct cost spike
actions.because: Direct costs rose {{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:pct}} ({{mv:direct_costs.mom@2026-04:abs}}) month-on-month against revenue growth of only {{mv:revenue.mom@2026-04:pct}}, dragging gross profit down {{mv:gross_profit.mom@2026-04:pct}} and EBITDA down {{mv:ebitda.mom@2026-04:pct}}.
actions.todo: Ask finance to break down the {{m:direct_costs@2026-04}} direct cost line by component to identify what drove the increase versus {{p:2026-04}} and whether it is one-off or structural.

actions.heading: Review payables surge
actions.because: Trade payables rose {{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:pct}} ({{mv:payables.mom@2026-04:abs}}) this month and {{mv:payables.yoy@2026-04:pct}} year-on-year, reaching {{m:payables@2026-04}}.
actions.todo: Have finance confirm whether the increase reflects new supplier terms, delayed payments, or cost pass-through linked to the direct cost rise, and check ageing.

actions.heading: Assess year-on-year profitability decline
actions.because: PAT fell {{mv:pat.yoy@2026-04:pct}} ({{mv:pat.yoy@2026-04:abs}}) versus the same month last year, with revenue down {{mv:revenue.yoy@2026-04:pct}} while direct costs rose {{mv:direct_costs.yoy@2026-04:pct}}.
actions.todo: Board to request a year-on-year margin review from the CA to understand whether this is pricing, volume, or cost-driven before next quarter's planning.

actions.heading: Monitor large cash balance
actions.because: Cash and bank stand at {{m:cash_and_bank@2026-04}}, up {{mv:cash_and_bank.yoy@2026-04:pct}} year-on-year, alongside working capital of {{m:working_capital@2026-04}}.
actions.todo: No immediate action needed; board may wish to discuss deployment or utilisation plans for the accumulated cash at the next meeting.
